move: knockout word drops, blows up to reveal image, circle, slice, stripe wipes
how: An SVG mask knocks the word DROP out of a cream rect over a sunset image scaling 1.25→1.05; the <text> drops from y -700 with expo.out, squashes scaleY 0.82 yoyo on landing, then at 19% scales to 14 with expo.in so the letter interiors swallow the frame and the image is full-bleed. 28%: a black layer blooms via clip-path circle 0→75% (expo.inOut) and IT lands from y -500 with bounce.out and a scaleX 1.15/scaleY 0.85 squash. 44%: an ocean image slices open from clip-path inset 50% top/bottom to 0 (expo.inOut 0.6s) while LIKE drops through from yPercent -250 and exits to +250. 62%: four bars scale x 0→1 with stagger 0.07 (expo.inOut), then an aurora image wipes diagonally via a polygon clip-path and HOT snaps in from scale 4 / opacity 0, its letter-spacing easing out to .05em. 92%: the cream rect (mask temporarily removed) wipes down over everything and the mask is restored at the last frame.
adapt: Replace the four words, the three images and the cream/black/red/yellow palette; keep the beat spacing (0, 2.8, 4.4, 6.2, 9.2 of 10s) and the mask blow-up at 1.9s with expo.in.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the SVG mask, word layers, circle, bars and images with the initial autoAlpha/clip-path sets; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the beats at 0.28, 0.44, 0.62, 0.72 and 0.92 of D. The SVG mask id must be unique per instance; attr mask toggles and #id selectors must be el-scoped; from() on #tx needs immediateRender:false.
caveats: SVG mask id #m1 collides if two instances mount
render.json duration is 10s while the catalog lists 16s
the #bars .bar background-attachment: fixed rule is overridden and unused
